data.content: Implementation complete on branch knots-f904-sentinel-pid-aware at a015f572aaac1bf74d409723647af7c825c73a1e. Scope: .claude/helpers/sentinel-recovery.cjs and cli/src/__tests__/sentinel-singleton.test.ts. Behavior: sentinel recovery now classifies watcher PID liveness, preserves stale-heartbeat watchers with live/EPERM PIDs, still recovers ESRCH-dead watcher PIDs, and preserves no-PID legacy recovery plus manual notification text. Fixed stale test repoRoot depth so sentinel-singleton actually loads the protected helper. Gates: node --check .claude/helpers/sentinel-recovery.cjs; vitest sentinel-singleton 7/7; vitest sentinel-singleton+root-resolver-parity+de-tmux-runtime 16/16; pnpm --dir cli exec tsc --noEmit; git diff --check; .audit/private-guard.sh clean. Provider verifier task task-cf0bfea9-2e73-4dc3-8b38-57ffe53a13fd was launched read-only but was still running on first result check, so no provider verdict was used for this commit.
